statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Societes (RCS), online at www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutes and RCS filings are drawn in French (or German); the corporate name must be available in Latin script and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Luxembourg corporate name, protected trademark, or domain-style designation (Article 1-13, Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies; Article 6, Law of 19 December 2002 on the RCS). For an SCSp, the designation 'Societe en commandite speciale' or the abbreviation 'SCSp' must be affixed before or after the name in all legal acts and invoices.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / Bank - requires prior CSSF (financial supervisor) authorization
Assurance / Reassurance - requires Commissariat aux Assurances (CAA) approval
Fonds / SICAV / SICAF / Fonds de placement - requires CSSF licence
Societe de gestion - requires CSSF authorisation as a management company
Bourse - requires Ministry of Finance regulatory consent
Etat / Gouvernement / Commune - misleading official references require ministerial approval
Universite / Haute ecole - requires Ministry of Education consent
Organisme notifie / Notified body - requires ILNAS and EU Commission recognition for testing-lab business scope
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the LBR/RCS registrar refuses the requested name, the Luxembourg notary or counsel may file a judicial application with the Commercial Chamber of the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg within 15 days of formal refusal (summary relief available) under the Law of 19 December 2002; the RCS registrar must comply once the court decision is final. A rejected name may be re-filed only after a material change to the token sequence, and a successful reservation may be renewed once for a further 30 days before expiry if no conflicting name has been registered in the interim.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual address is not compliant. The SCSp must maintain a genuine registered office in Luxembourg capable of receiving legal notifications actionable under Article 1-13 of the Law of 10 August 1915, as amended. Domiciliation agents approved by the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice may lawfully host the registered office under the Law of 31 May 1999 on the domiciliation of companies. For an ISIC 7120 dangerous-goods testing laboratory, physical premises, equipment, technical staff, and ISO/IEC 17025 (ILAC MRA) or equivalent accreditation are de facto and de jure mandatory for UN38.3 and CE-RED certification scope; a pure domiciliation arrangement without operational substance will not support the licensed lab activity or Luxembourg tax-resident commercial substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Elevated: estimated 60%-75% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the RCS registrar, the Luxembourg police Economic Investigation Unit, or CSSF-accredited AML auditors within the first 24 months of operation, owing to the hazardous-goods testing and CE-marking exposure; additionally, ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation surveillance audits occur at least annually and may be unannounced.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Amended Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), Articles 536-1 to 536-22 as introduced by the Law of 11 July 2013; Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS), Articles 9-10; Law of 11 July 2013 on Luxembourg Business Registers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), operating the Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), with electronic filing via the eJustice / lbr.lu portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Partnership agreement / deed of formation (contrat de société) deposited with the RCS, followed by court-ordered or registry-initiated publication in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum capital applies to an SCSp; partnership capital is freely determined in the partnership agreement. Contributions may be made in cash, in kind, or as services. No escrow or blocked bank account declaration is required at formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Pro-Forma First Board Resolution of the General Partner of LU SCSp. At a meeting held on 2 January 2026, it was RESOLVED: (1) the Partnership Agreement is approved and adopted as executed; (2) the issue and subscription of partnership interests are ratified per the capital schedule; (3) the registered office is established at 12, Rue de Bonnevoie, L-1260 Luxembourg; (4) [Name] is appointed Manager (Gérant) with full authority to file the deed with the RCS; (5) the Manager is authorized to open bank accounts and execute regulatory, environmental, and industrial licensing applications. Effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the SCSp Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding partners and optional notary; no mandatory notarization unless real property is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the written partnership agreement in English or French setting forth the firm name, registered office in Luxembourg, corporate purpose (battery safety testing, UN38.3 drop testing, CE-RED electromagnetic laboratory), the general partner (commandité), limited partners (commanditaires), capital schedule, and management clauses. All partners must sign and authenticate the deed; obtain the registered-office owner's written consent.
required_dossiers: Draft partnership agreement (statuts)
Valid passport or national ID of each partner
Certificate of good standing of corporate general partner, if applicable
Written consent of the registered office owner
Beneficial ownership identification forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On objection or requested amendment, revise the draft, obtain re-execution by all partners, and reissue before filing; no registry remedy is needed at this pre-filing stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration Filing via Luxembourg Business Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (lbr.lu / eJustice electronic filing window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed partnership agreement and duly signed RCS registration form electronically on lbr.lu. Attach the manager's declaration of acceptance and identification. Pay the statutory filing fee. The RCS verifies the legal form, the registered office address, and the manager's appointment, then assigns the RCS registration number and LEI.
required_dossiers: Executed partnership agreement
RCS registration form (formulaire C), signed by the general partner
Manager's declaration of acceptance and identity copy
Proof of registered office availability and owner consent
Payment receipt of RCS filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query, correct the flagged particulars (e.g. manager signature or office address) and resubmit through the same portal within 15 days; the filing is deemed perfected upon issuance of the RCS extract.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Electronic Companies and Associations Compendium (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers — RESA publication service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following successful RCS registration, the registry arranges publication of the constitutive deed and the appointment of the manager in the Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations. The partnership must verify the published extract, confirm accuracy, and retain the certified publication notice as third-party evidence of legal existence.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract
RESA publication notice (automatic post-registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a discrepancy in the RESA notice, file a rectification application with Luxembourg Business Registers, attaching the correct particulars and the original RCS extract.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration — National Identification and VAT Accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD); Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the post-incorporation tax registration through MyGuichet.lu. Obtain the national identification number (matricule) and the VAT number from the AEDT, and file the partnership's opening declarations with the ACD. Given the SCSp's tax-transparent status, also request confirmation of the classification for the testing laboratory's future VAT position on cross-border services.
required_dossiers: RCS extract not older than 3 months
Executed partnership agreement
Identification of the general partner, manager, and limited partners
Description of intended UN38.3 / CE-RED laboratory activities
Authorisation forms for tax mailbox access
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEDT or ACD queries the filing, resubmit the revised electronic declarations within the statutory deadline; any tax assessment may be appealed under the Luxembourg General Tax Law within 3 months of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Document Legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution and national legalization / apostille authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate bank account using the RCS extract, partnership agreement, and beneficial ownership declaration; configure the target payment rails (Wire Transfer and Wise) with IBAN access. Obtain certified copies and, where foreign signatures are involved, apostille certifications for the industrial license application dossiers.
required_dossiers: RCS extract (not older than 3 months)
Partnership agreement
Beneficial owner register extract
Identification documents of the manager and partners
Bank signatory mandate and powers of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank challenges the pass-through structure, provide an updated KYC file, the RCS extract, and a legal opinion confirming the SCSp's tax transparency and limited-partner liability shield.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie (Ministry of the Economy) — Directorate General for Industry; Office Luxembourgeois de l'Accréditation et de la Surveillance (OLAS) for ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory accreditation; communal administration of the registered-office commune for the classified establishment permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Permis d'exploitation d'établissement classé (classified establishment operating permit) under the Law of 30 July 2013 on industrial development and the Law of 9 June 2016 on environmental permits, together with ISO/IEC 17025 testing-laboratory accreditation issued by OLAS.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Environment Agency of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / notification category (classe 4) — a full EIA report is not mandated for a UN38.3 battery-testing and CE-RED electromagnetic laboratory provided annual hazardous battery storage and throughput remain below the low-tier thresholds of Directive 2012/18/EU (Seveso III) and the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 9 June 2016; a compliance declaration and environmental registration dossier must be filed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 16 November 2009 on urban and industrial wastewater discharges (pH 6.5-9; limit values for Pb, Cd, Ni, Hg per Directive 2000/60/EC); VOC emissions from soldering and EMC test equipment must stay below the thresholds of Directive 2010/75/EU on industrial emissions; spent battery handling, storage, and dispatches must conform to Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 on batteries and waste batteries, including the ADR dangerous-goods packing and marking rules for UN38.3-tested cells.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (certificat de sécurité incendie) issued by the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS); structural load inspection certificate by an approved engineer for the battery drop-test tower and EMC shielded chambers; and workplace clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) covering electrical safety, manual handling, battery thermal-runaway containment, and restricted-access signage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct taxes; integrated digital portal: MyGuichet.lu / guichet.lu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign SCSp must register its identity with the Luxembourg Register of Commerce and Companies (RCS) via the MyGuichet single point, obtaining a 13-digit national identification number (numéro d'identification). If taxable supplies are made in Luxembourg, the partnership must file VAT Form 1 with the AEDT, provide proof of its registered seat/activities, and, unless established in the EU or in a country with a tax administrative-assistance agreement, appoint an approved Luxembourg fiscal representative. The VAT number takes the form 'LU + 8 digits'. No minimum capital or local substance is required for the SCSp itself, but a domestic tax representative contact is mandatory for non-EU investors without a permanent establishment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not apply a 'check-the-box' election for the SCSp, which is by law fiscally transparent for income tax, municipal business tax and net wealth tax. No corporate tax election is available; however, the SCSp may opt for VAT grouping (assujetti unique) with its qualifying subsidiaries if certain control conditions are met, and the partnership remains subject to hybrid-mismatch rules under ATAD, e.g., by electing to align the tax treatment of a partner under a foreign partnership analogy.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general registration threshold for domestic taxable supplies, but a small-business exemption applies up to EUR 30,000 annual turnover; non-established businesses have no threshold and must register for any taxable supply; intra-EU distance sales of goods trigger Luxembourg VAT registration when total cross-border distance sales to Luxembourg consumers exceed EUR 10,000 per calendar year.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing is only imposed for B2G invoices issued to central government entities, which must be sent through the PEPPOL network; there is no real-time fiscal clearance, no continuous transaction controls, and no digital stamping requirement for B2B or B2C invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported outside the EU qualify for 0% VAT provided they physically leave the EU by a prescribed deadline and proof of export is obtained within 90 days. For cross-border B2B testing services (dangerous goods UN38.3 drop testing and CE-RED electromagnetic lab), the place of supply is the customer's country; if the customer is a taxable person established outside the EU, the supply is outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT, effectively zero-rated, conditional on obtaining adequate commercial evidence of the customer's business establishment, e.g., a tax registration certificate or foreign VAT ID. Supplies to EU taxable customers are subject to reverse charge in the customer's EU Member State and require the customer's valid EU VAT number.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD – Single Administrative Document)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR consignment note evidencing physical departure of goods
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank/currency receipt evidencing receipt of foreign payment
UN38.3 test report and CE-RED conformity file referencing the export order
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Luxembourg tax authorities may conduct post-export audit checks and require production of all listed documentation. If export zero-rating is denied or proven fraudulent, the VAT becomes immediately collectable with statutory default interest; late payment penalties and corrected assessments up to 20% of the amount due may be imposed; the standard statute of limitation is three years, extended to five years in the case of misdeclaration and up to ten years for criminal tax fraud. Serious abuse may trigger criminal sanctions, joint liability of the fiscal representative, and withdrawal of zero-rating benefits for previously filed returns.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), operating within the Eurosystem under the European Central Bank framework; prudential and AML/CFT supervisory functions are exercised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF). The BCL manages the national TARGET2 settlement accounts, oversees market infrastructure, and compiles balance-of-payments statistics reported by Luxembourg credit institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg is a euro-area member with full EUR convertibility on both current and capital accounts pursuant to Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) and the OECD Code of Liberalisation of Capital Movements. There are no exchange controls, no restrictions on cross-border payments, and no differentiated regime for non-resident investors. Profit remittance from an SCSp is freely permitted; distributions by the fiscally transparent SCSp are not subject to Luxembourg withholding tax at the partnership level. The only practical constraints are bank-level AML/KYC due diligence and the monthly BCL balance-of-payments statistical declaration required for each cross-border transaction above EUR 12,500.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Luxembourg imposes no surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no statutory timeline for export proceeds. Receipts from UN38.3 battery-safety testing and CE-RED electromagnetic laboratory services may be retained in EUR or any freely convertible currency with no central-bank approval. The sole overlay is statistical: the credit institution must report cross-border flows to the BCL under the balance-of-payments framework, using the appropriate transaction purpose code, for amounts equal to or exceeding EUR 12,500.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium for operational collection and foreign-currency clearing of low-value test-fee receivables; Low for capital escrow or capital-injection functions. Wise Europe SA (the 'Wise' product) holds a Belgian Electronic Money Institution licence passported into Luxembourg under PSD2/EMD2 and can provide a multi-currency business wallet (EUR, USD, GBP, CNH) to the SCSp. Legal constraints: (i) an EMI cannot take deposits, grant credit, or operate a classical escrow/segregated account; (ii) customer funds are safeguarded but not protected by the EU Deposit Guarantee Scheme; (iii) practical transaction velocity limits (EUR 10,000-50,000 per transaction) render the rail unsuitable for capital calls or equipment disbursements; (iv) the EMI must still verify ultimate beneficial owners against the Luxembourg RBE register. Recommended architecture: use Wise for sub-EUR 20,000 invoice collection from non-EU battery producers with same-day conversion, then sweep the balance to the BIL/BGL escrow or operational account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Luxembourg does not statutorily require physical presence; remote onboarding using video identification, electronic signatures and certified document copies is permitted under CSSF AML/CFT rules and CSSF Regulation 12-02. In current banking practice, a 30-45 minute compliance interview with the SCSp's general partner (a Luxembourg-incorporated SPV) and its authorised signatories is required, and the interview is generally accepted via secure video conference. A de facto physical session may be requested if the ownership chain spans more than two intermediary jurisdictions, if a UBO is a PEP, or if the bank classifies the structure as complex. For a Low_Risk_Standard hardware-testing SCSp, fully remote onboarding with couriered notarised documents is achievable within two to three weeks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SCSp is a partnership without legal personality; the bank cannot rely on a conventional corporate registration and must see through to each partner as a beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised partnership agreement, Luxembourg RBE registration extract, current capital-call resolutions, a signed UBO schedule listing each partner's full name, address, ownership percentage and tax residence, and a Luxembourg counsel opinion confirming due formation and valid representation of the SCSp by its general partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU partners or a newly incorporated general partner with no audited financial history creates source-of-funds uncertainty.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve-month source-of-funds pack comprising signed sale/purchase agreements, bank statements, audited annual accounts of each contributing partner, apostilled corporate extracts, bank reference letters from the remitting institutions, negative World-Check/Dow Jones screening results, and an independent due-diligence memorandum where internal thresholds require it.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commercial scope covers testing of dangerous goods (UN38.3 drop testing and CE-RED electromagnetic lab), triggering product-liability, insurance and licensing review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation certificate, UN38.3 designation letter from the competent authority, professional-indemnity insurance policy with a minimum coverage of EUR 2,000,000, Luxembourg laboratory lease, signed testing-pipeline contracts with battery manufacturers, and a compliance note confirming the SCSp carries no regulated financial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fiscally transparent SCSp with no corporate income tax on its own income raises 'letterbox' and BEPS/ATAD substance concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance file containing the physical laboratory lease, Luxembourg payroll records, VAT registration number (RC E-number), annual tax filings (Form 500/510), transfer-pricing documentation for intercompany service fees, and a partner-jurisdiction tax opinion confirming the transparency treatment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP status of a limited partner or GP officer triggers enhanced due diligence and possible internal escalation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal PEP declaration, an independent source-of-wealth report certified by a recognised auditor, FATCA/CRS self-certifications, a senior compliance officer approval memo, and a commitment to enhanced ongoing transaction monitoring.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Wire-Transfer Protocol: (1) Open a Capital Escrow Account at BIL (BIC BILLLULL) or BGL BNP Paribas (BIC BGLLLULL) in the name 'SCSp [Name] represented by its general partner [GP Name]'. (2) For EEA investors, execute a SEPA Credit Transfer in EUR to the dedicated IBAN; for non-EEA investors, instruct a SWIFT MT103 with the purpose code for direct investment (BPM6 'Direct investment - equity capital') and include in Field 70 the text 'SCSP CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION - CAPITAL CALL NO. [X]'. (3) For USD injections, route through the bank's New York correspondent using CHIPS and the bank's UID/ABA; for renminbi, use CNH clearing through the Hong Kong clearing bank and convert to EUR at spot. (4) Verification: the bank screens the remitter against sanctions, matches the remitter to the RBE-listed partner, reviews the signed capital-call resolution and any source-of-funds documents, and only then releases funds from escrow. All transactions equal to or above EUR 12,500 are captured in the BCL balance-of-payments declaration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing Rails: SWIFT MT103 is the default fast-rail for supplier invoices covering battery test chambers, vibration tables, environmental chambers and calibration services; Field 70 must state the supplier invoice number and 'UN38.3 LAB PURCHASE'. For intra-EEA disbursements up to EUR 100,000, SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) provides near-real-time clearing through TARGET2; larger amounts may use standard SEPA Credit Transfer with T+0/T+1 value dating. For capital-equipment procurement from Asia, the SCSp may instruct its bank to issue an irrevocable documentary letter of credit under UCP 600 transmitted by SWIFT MT700/MT707; the beneficiary presents the commercial invoice, bill of lading, packing list, insurance certificate and inspection certificate to its confirming bank. Disbursements are limited to the operational tranche of the account after all escrow-release milestones have been satisfied; every outbound wire remains subject to the EUR 12,500 BCL statistical reporting threshold.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD deliverable FX forward with maturities up to 12 months, executed under a bilateral ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with the account bank.
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on USD/CNH or EUR/CNH for hedging test-service receivables invoiced to Chinese battery manufacturers, net-settled in EUR or USD.
EUR/USD cross-currency swap for balance-sheet hedging of long-term capital-call funding positions.
Vanilla EUR/USD and USD/CNH FX options, including zero-premium collars, executed through a MiFID II-licensed investment firm.
FX swap consisting of simultaneous spot and forward legs for temporary treasury cash-sweeping between the EUR operational account and USD supplier accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RCS annual data confirmation (confirmation annuelle des données)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers — Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), eJustice portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after the anniversary of the RCS registration; repeated annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: RCS formal reminder; fines up to EUR 1,000; unresolved non-confirmation for more than three months after notice exposes the SCSp to administrative data rectification and strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements / comptes annuels deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers — RCS (financial statements registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than seven months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, filing must be completed by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit triggers monetary penalties (up to EUR 1,000 plus court-fixed daily fine), court orders for compliance, and administrative strike-off after prolonged default (typically after unpurged notices exceeding 12 months).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO confirmation and ownership transfer notification (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers — Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary of the RBE registration; any partner/UBO transfer must be notified within 30 days of the transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to EUR 5,000; severe or repeated failures may expose managers to criminal AML sanctions (fines up to EUR 125,000 or imprisonment) and negative RCS standing culminating in strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: ILNAS/OAA annual accreditation surveillance dossier (ISO/IEC 17025) for UN38.3 drop-testing scope
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual surveillance assessment must be scheduled before the certificate anniversary; the dossier is due in Q1 of each calendar year or as specified by the ILNAS surveillance plan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failed or missed surveillance leads to suspension and withdrawal of accreditation, invalidating UN38.3 test certificates and preventing CE-RED ballistic/electromagnetic certification issuance until reaccreditation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory audit for an SCSp qualifying as a Luxembourg small undertaking (not exceeding two of three: balance sheet total EUR 4.4M, net turnover EUR 8.8M, average workforce 50) for two consecutive financial years; audit becomes compulsory if thresholds are exceeded, the entity is in a regulated/financial sector, or partners representing at least 10% request it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (Law of 19 December 2002 on annual accounts, as amended, implementing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU); IFRS is permitted for consolidated financial statements and may be elected voluntarily.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp's manager is legally responsible for the RBE file in Luxembourg. Every transfer or modification of partnership interests/beneficial ownership must be notified to the RBE within 30 days, and an annual confirmation must be filed within 30 days following the anniversary of the RBE registration. The annual confirmation restates each beneficial owner's name, date/place of birth, nationality, residential address and the nature and extent of economic interest; a no-change status still requires active confirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Partners (SCSp ownership interests and transfers)
Minute Book of Partners' Meetings and resolutions
Register of Beneficial Owners (mirroring RBE filings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 – 3,500 per year for standard registered office/agent; USD 2,500 – 6,500 per year for a full corporate secretarial and RCS/RBE filing package.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit if small-entity waiver applies; a certified Luxembourg audit for the SCSp testing lab would amount to USD 8,000 – 25,000; an agreed-upon review is USD 4,000 – 7,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (Luxembourg-City aggregate: CIT 17.00% + solidarity surcharge 1.19% + municipal business tax (IMT) 6.75%)
